name: FOUNDER5-the-old-instant
note: 00:00Z again: a player who first played on the evening of the 24th in the Americas - before the 25th on their own clock - holds nothing.

name: FOUNDER5-the-cutoff-an-open-end
note: Every registered account a founder, however late it first played: the title is no longer closed.

name: FOUNDER5-the-cutoff-exclusive
note: The last second of the 24th at UTC-12 falls outside.

name: FOUNDER5-the-list-ignored
old: if (!held.includes('founder') && isNamedFounder(player, env)) held.push('founder');   // FOUNDER5: or by name
note: A player Mac names in FOUNDER_HANDLES holds nothing: the one way to reach a player no record proves is gone.

name: FOUNDER5-the-list-held-twice
old: if (!held.includes('founder') && isNamedFounder(player, env)) held.push('founder');   // FOUNDER5: or by name
new: if (isNamedFounder(player, env)) held.push('founder');   // FOUNDER5: or by name
note: A founder by the date AND the name is offered the title twice in the wardrobe.

name: FOUNDER5-the-list-grants-guests
why: Belt and braces, kept as the developers' and moderators' guards are: handleList drops empty entries, so no set holds '' and a guest's NULL handle - the one handle a guest has - is never in it. The guard says the law where it is read; the pin that a guest holds none (founder5's names) stands either way.

name: FOUNDER5-the-list-case-blind
note: A handle named in another case than it was registered in holds nothing - handle_lc is what uniqueness is on.

name: FOUNDER5-live-no-link-at-a-save
old: if (!have) await linkFirstPlay({ db }, playerId, characterId);   // FOUNDER5: a new slot - the character may have arrived
note: A character backed up onto a new account links nothing: the account waits on a person to re-run 0078, the very input Mac asked to be without.

name: FOUNDER5-live-no-link-at-customs
old: await linkFirstPlay({ db }, playerId, origin);   // FOUNDER5: the character arrived on this account
note: A character brought into the realm links nothing.

name: FOUNDER5-live-the-census-unasked
note: The census - where every guest-era Renown track was gathered when the realm opened - links nothing.

name: FOUNDER5-live-later-too
old: ' WHERE id = ?1 AND (SELECT t FROM linked) < MIN(created_at, COALESCE(registered_at, created_at), COALESCE(first_played_at, created_at))'
note: A link writes whatever it finds, NULL or later: an account linked to nothing has its column written, and one linked to a later row has its first play moved.

name: FOUNDER5-live-itself
why: The account's own first play is never earlier than its own MIN(created_at, registered_at, first_played_at), so linking to itself can never pass the earlier-only guard. Kept as 0078 keeps it: the statement says it asks OTHER rows.

name: FOUNDER5-live-the-save-index-dropped
old: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_saves_character ON saves (character_id);
note: A save asked by character reads the whole table.
